title: add-rag-scenario-composer-and-typed-toolkit-quickstart
author: Sana Iqbal
description: Introduce a compact interactive RAG Scenario Composer quickstart plus a small typed-toolkit for generating TypeScript bindings from tool schemas. Motivation: teams repeatedly ask for a reproducible way to author, iterate, and share RAG scenarios with typed tool-call contracts and a lightweight devloop for local debugging. This quickstart bundles: 1) an authoring playground (single-page React) that saves scenario checkpoints to a local JSON catalog, 2) a 'typed-toolkit' generator that produces TypeScript types and runtime stubs from tool OpenAPI/JSON-schema-like definitions, 3) example runners for Node and a small Go shim demonstrating how typed tool calls are validated at runtime, 4) a playwright-based smoke harness and CI job for scenario replay, 5) devcontainer and live-reload for fast onboarding, and 6) telemetry probe presets (span and metric hooks) that integrate with the existing quickstart telemetry presets. Checklist: - [x] Authoring UI and static assets - [x] typed-toolkit generator and example bindings - [x] Node + Go runtime examples and README guidance - [x] Devcontainer and local-run scripts - [x] Playwright smoke CI and example scenarios - [x] Docs site entry and concise quickstart guide - [x] Telemetry presets and minimal instrumentation Usage notes: the typed-toolkit intentionally produces minimal runtime (validate+stub) to encourage integration with customers' existing tool implementations; this is not an exhaustive codegen. See the README for how to wire the generated bindings into a Redwood agent or micro-orchestrator. Related: plugs into ENG-1592 (scenario authoring backlog) and SUP-4421 (customer request for typed tool contracts). This PR is intended as a self-contained quickstart; follow-up items (split into separate PRs) will add more language bindings and extend the generator to emit Kotlin/Swift shims. Links: Quickstart demo GIF and design docs are embedded in playbooks/scenario-composer/README.md.

- Added interactive RAG Scenario Composer quickstart with typed-toolkit generator and Node/Go examples.

notes_for_changelog: Experimental quickstart: introduces typed-toolkit (TypeScript stubs) and scenario-composer playground. Not recommended for production use; intended as onboarding and developer loop material.
guidance: To try locally: 1) cd playbooks/scenario-composer/web && pnpm install && pnpm dev, 2) run typed-toolkit generator against playbooks/scenario-composer/playbooks.json to generate bindings, 3) cd examples/node-runner && pnpm start to exercise scenario replay. See README for env vars and sample scenarios.
qa_steps: 1) Start devcontainer and open localhost:3000 to confirm composer loads default scenario. 2) Run generator CLI on included sample tool spec; confirm generated types compile in examples/node-runner. 3) Run 'pnpm test:e2e' which executes Playwright scenarios against local mocks. 4) Inspect telemetry/presets for emitted spans in the local Zipkin/OTLP sink.
